relatedArticles.headline: Like father, like son: Conines join exclusive company with HR feat
relatedArticles.blurb:
MIAMI – It might be time to anoint the Conines as the “Marlins Family.”
When Griffin Conine demolished Cubs lefty Caleb Thielbar’s inside fastball for a two-run homer in the fifth inning of Saturday’s 6-5 loss at loanDepot park, it made him part of baseball history.
